# Workflow regression fixtures

The real-export JSON files are analysis/packaging fixtures only; tests never run these graphs or acquire their weights. Original workflow bytes and upstream notes are preserved. Cody has confirmed the other license information; the owner confirmation is recorded in docs/REVIEW_BEFORE_PUBLICATION.md. Third-party workflow material retains its applicable terms; the project code license does not silently relicense these workflows.

comfy_analysis_object_info.json retains representative node input/output schemas from reviewed target evidence. Model-choice lists were minimized to the three exact selected Z Image filenames, removing the private local catalog. It is an offline test schema sample, not evidence that a recipient has those models/nodes. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for retained notices and attribution.
